Main_Manuscript.old: Main models used equal gene weights and a finite-sample-corrected block-cluster sandwich covariance. Confidence intervals used a t distribution with G−1 degrees of freedom, where G is the number of observed blocks. European LDetect and frozen ASN LDetect boundaries defined EUR and EAS clustering, respectively.[7] Boundaries were not treated as individual-level LD estimates; the conditional population contained 169 EUR and 148 ASN blocks.

Main_Manuscript.old: We examined whether excluding 56 fixed reference/seed gene identities also removed the regional inputs represented among the remaining genes. Using GRCh37 GENCODE v19 gene-body intervals, the membership mask (Rule A) excluded a non-seed gene if its annotated transcription start site or any position in its frozen mapping list overlapped a seed gene body. The mask used all frozen mapped positions, not just minimum-P variants or endpoint-matched inputs. Entire genes were removed; inputs were not trimmed and scores were not recomputed under a new mapping scheme. Unresolved annotations and input-based overlap were recorded separately.

Main_Manuscript.old: Liver-trait gene support was associated with HCC association tails, but its interpretation depended on which inputs and gene populations were represented. Excluding 56 known gene identities left extensive representation of seed-gene-body inputs among recurrent candidates. A membership mask addressing those connections retained descriptive HCC enrichment while moving the European conditional breadth estimate from approximately 0.692 to 0.003. These observations connect gene-level recurrence to regional representation rather than establishing new HCC effector genes.
Main_Manuscript.new: Liver-trait gene support was associated with HCC association tails, but its interpretation depended on which inputs and gene populations were represented. Main_Manuscript.old: (a) Gene support is the top-5% rank of aggregated source-mapped inputs from each of 11 non-HCC liver traits. Fifty-six fixed reference/seed identities are excluded from nominee and background comparisons. No eQTL significance threshold is imposed by the mapping loader, and HCC statistics do not enter nomination. (b) Conditional models originally use 1652 genes; the reference-gene-body membership mask retains 1259. A separate outcome-selected input audit comprises 283 genes, 1465 support events and 3224 within-gene cross-trait pairs. These are distinct populations, not sequential validation stages. (c) The membership mask removes an entire gene when its TSS or any frozen mapped position overlaps a seed gene body. Liver support and global HCC ranks remain fixed. The mask is a result-informed population sensitivity, not a new input-trimming analysis or causal decomposition.

Main_Manuscript.old: Equal-gene-weight M2 compares at least four versus one to three supporting traits, adjusting for peak liver strength, strength quintile, gene length, mapped record count and adjacent-liver expression. Points and bars show estimates and 95% block-cluster t intervals in inverse-normal rank-evidence units; the dashed line marks zero. Original samples contain 1652 genes (443 high-breadth, 1209 lower-breadth), with 169 EUR and 148 ASN blocks. Masked samples contain 1259 genes (214 high-breadth, 1045 lower-breadth), with 136 EUR and 126 ASN blocks. HCC ranks and covariate standardization remain fixed, but analyzed populations differ. No causal attribution or statistical test of the difference between the two estimates is implied. EUR denotes European and EAS East Asian assessment. Intervals are exploratory, pointwise and not selection-adjusted.

Supplementary_Methods.old: LDetect EUR/ASN intervals supply block boundaries; 1000 Genomes EUR supplies signed LD for the regional comparisons. These resources are not interchangeable.
Supplementary_Methods.new: European (EUR) and Asian (ASN) LDetect intervals supply block boundaries; 1000 Genomes EUR supplies signed LD for the regional comparisons. These resources are not interchangeable.

Supplementary_Methods.old: Across the original 283 candidates, TSS blocks could be assigned to 277 genes across 22 blocks; actual inputs and minimum inputs involved 32 and 12 blocks, respectively. These are different representations, not counts of independent signals. Tables S19–S20 record overlap with the historical regional comparison registry; their software eligibility fields do not certify current signal-sharing inference.

Supplementary_Methods.old: The 56 fixed seed identities were mapped to GRCh37 GENCODE v19 gene bodies. Their union contained 55 intervals totaling 5,245,597 bp. A non-seed gene was excluded if its TSS or any frozen mapped position fell within that union. The rule removes whole genes, does not truncate mapping lists, and uses frozen inputs regardless of endpoint availability or input P value. Liver support flags, B, S, global HCC ranks, covariates and standardization were retained. Original marginal-support trimming was not repeated after masking. Retained model membership was the intersection of the original sample with the retained gene set, with cluster uncertainty recalculated using the remaining blocks.

Supplementary_Methods.old: All 21,986,982 European and 7,735,435 East Asian raw rows were scanned. Raw-file MD5 values matched the recorded official checksums. Within the implemented autosomal same-chromosome plus-strand chain contract, independent interval enumeration found no forward multiple hits, missed unique hits or mismatched unique coordinates. This does not validate conversions outside that contract. Literal GRCh37 coordinate/unordered-allele keys were compared with all 22 chromosomes of the frozen caches.

Supplementary_Methods.old: All 18,321 gene scores and their boundary/neutral ranks were replayed. Top-5% sets, candidate membership and the original model sample were unchanged. The 56 previously reported model specifications, including their existing bootstrap and leave-one-block-out procedures, were regenerated on corrected outcomes. No new cutpoint, covariate, model family or colocalization fit was introduced. Table S9 contains corrected model outputs; Table S11 contains corrected block influence summaries. Conflict handling passed 253 regression checks, including real source pairs through the historical adapter; the independent score/membership replay passed 53 checks.

Supplementary_Methods.old: Numerical filtering excluded 301,087 EUR raw records, none of which exactly matched the frozen variant keys; no EAS raw records failed that contract. This finding concerns membership, not validation of signed effect semantics. The deposited METAL Weight values and the reported total sample size differ; their relationship has not been established as an RSS sample-size contract. Deposited beta/SE values are not certified log-odds estimates. Rank-based HCC evidence uses the deposited P field and makes no signed-effect claim.

Cover_Letter.old: Reconstruction of 1465 support events among 283 selected candidates showed how known inputs were represented across genes and traits. The study separates the identities in a candidate list from the genetic inputs represented by that list. It shows why excluding known genes can leave their regional evidence distributed across other candidates, and why this distinction matters when interpreting cross-trait breadth. This question is relevant to the Journal’s readers using gene-level summaries to interpret human genetic associations.
